text:
Maya Patel: quick async standup — what I did: merged PR #1423 (route-policy cleanup), kicked off a small canary against staging. Observed a burst of 429s on /v1/complete during the canary. Blockers: need infra to either bump dedicated-pool-3 concurrency or we tune the token-bucket settings. Today: open a migration PR for policies and dig into rate-limiter metrics. pinging @Ravi Singh for quota check.

Ravi Singh: saw the 429 spike in logs too, looking into the ingress traces now. initial hunch: token-bucket refill rate + burst config mismatch for service keys. can you paste the canary trace or curl that reproduces it? I'll prepare a quick patch to increase burst for dedicated-pool-3 in staging.

Maya Patel: here's the minimal repro and the trace snippet I grabbed from staging:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -d '{"input":"test"}' https://staging.api.redwood/v1/complete -v

trace-id: t-9a2b7f
steps: accept -> route -> rate_check -> 429
logs: ingress-proxy-7: rate_limit=exceeded token_bucket_remaining=0 refill_rate=5/s
```

Corey Nguyen: left a review on #1426 (auth header validation). small nit about the header parsing but doesn't need to block the canary. once tests pass I'll approve.

Lee Park: on rotation today — if you want the staging burst bumped and a deploy, ping me. if we increase burst we should also check the token-refresh job's RBAC so it doesn't flood the pool.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for api-gateway v2.15 by Maya Patel at 4342109876. Staging: 3/10 hosts healthy.

Maya Patel: thanks — monitoring dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc123/rate-limiter?orgId=1&period=1h . 429s are concentrated around service-id=ingress-proxy-7, and correlate with a sudden drop in token_bucket_remaining. full canary trace above.

Ravi Singh: bump applied: increased burst factor to 1.5x on dedicated-pool-3 in staging. watching incoming traffic and refill metrics. will also open a tiny telemetry PR to surface per-key refill rates.

Corey Nguyen: one more thing — policy migration script should be idempotent; I left a code comment. not blocking merge but helpful to avoid churn if the migration runs twice.

Lee Park: ops note: background-embedder job shares the same logical token-bucket in staging, don't forget to bump its quota too if you expect sustained traffic. I can update after 10:30 PT.

Maya Patel: quick status check — are we green? can someone +1 the PRs so I can promote the canary? :thumbsup:

Ravi Singh: no 429s at 10:42 in staging after the bump. looks stable for the last 5m. I'll follow up with the telemetry patch.

Corey Nguyen: approving #1426 now.

Maya Patel: great — I'll merge the migration PR and promote. if this recurs I'll file a short postmortem and update the runbook. thanks everyone!
